{{PAGENAME}} is received from [[Krezvold]]. He says that he'd be happy to give it to you if you help him ruin [[Horadric]]'s mood. He wants you to get [[Ms. Charm]] to sing a song at the [[Talking Skull]] to make Horadric angry and jealous. 

Go to the [[The Dead Horse]] on {{Day|Lust}} to speak with Ms. Charm. She'll agree to come sing at your tavern, but the first song will cost you {{money|2000}}, but you can haggle to get the price down to {{money|1000}}. Go back to Krezvold and tell him the news and he'll give you the {{PAGENAME}}.

Krezvold will then ask you to help him find another expensive dagger, the [[Rare Dagger]], that he lost in the forest.
